jobs.title: Commercial Director
jobs.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The Opportunity This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Commercial Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay — strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results. Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role. jobs.description: Building a More Resilient World When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn't. At ClaimSorted, we're changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities. We're creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world's largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk. And we're moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for "how it's always been done." We're just getting started. There's never been a better time to join. The Role Handling claims at scale requires a strong operational foundation. As our Founding Strategy & Operations Analyst, you’ll help build the operational capability that lets ClaimSorted deliver market-leading claims handling while running efficiently as we grow. You’ll work with data to find problems, then take on the projects that fix them, increasing the speed and volume of operational change across the company. As part of this role you will: Design and implement efficient claims processes and procedures, and make sure they are adopted and hold up as the team grows. Build and manage the KPIs and metrics we use to handle claims and run the organisation as efficiently as possible. Analyse operational data to understand problems, surface insights, and turn them into practical solutions. Take ownership of small projects and support complex cross-functional initiatives, from scoping through to delivery. Work with teams across the company to make operational changes land quickly. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Veriff Network
jobs.description: About Veriff Veriff is building trust infrastructure for the internet. Our AI-powered identity verification and fraud prevention platform helps businesses across fintech, crypto, gaming, mobility and marketplaces know who their users are, and whether they can be trusted, in 230+ countries and territories. We build our own technology end to end, and every verification we run teaches us something about how fraud really works. The role Veriff sees fraud at a scale and breadth that no single platform can see on its own. Our job now is to turn that advantage into products customers can see, measure and act on, and to build the network that makes it compound. As Lead Product Manager for Fraud on the Veriff Network team, you will make the fraud detection, prevention and accuracy strengths of our product legible to customers. You will own the concrete product experiences that do this, such as a Feedback API that lets customers tell us what happened after a decision, fraud insights inside Station (our customer portal), and automated fraud reporting. You will also lead the customer engagement that turns those experiences into a feedback loop: customers share outcomes and signals, our detection gets sharper, and every platform on the network benefits. This is one of the first roles on the Veriff Network, and it directly shapes how we package, sell and grow our fraud offering. What success looks like In your first 90 days, you will have assessed our fraud product roadmap and packaging and agreed a revised version with product and fraud leadership. You will have identified the top three to five fraud product improvements, with the highest-priority items shaped and in development. By six months, the first updated fraud product offering is live with a group of design and beta partners. The manager will collaborate closely with engineering, construction, finance, legal, and network planning teams to ensure that selected sites meet operational, technical, and business requirements. Build and maintain market intelligence on emerging data center regions, supply trends, energy markets, and colocation pricing. Get close to the challenge As a Management Consultant, you’ll own defined workstreams with support from experienced project leaders. Depending on the engagement, you’ll: Find the story in the data: Analyse spending, suppliers, and operational challenges to develop practical recommendations clients can act on. Deploy our AI-enabled data solutions to drive efficient decision-making.
